strategy_roster.name: ALMA & UT Bot Confluence
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,72) and rsi(close,14) > 30 and adx(high,low,close,10) > 30 and close < bb_upper(close,20,3) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1 and atr(high,low,close,14) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(72), RSI(14), ADX(10), Bollinger(20,3), volume_ratio(20), and ATR(14) retain the documented numeric features; ALMA and the UT Bot signal are approximated or omitted. The 5x/4x ATR protection, cooldown, and optional time exit are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Hull MA Implied Volatility Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The unavailable Hull MA and implied-volatility indicators are represented by a prior 9-bar high breakout and an ATR(20) lower band. The documented 2x ATR stop is not a fixed percentage field, and the 15-minute execution layer is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: AIS3 Trading Robot Template
strategy_roster.notes: The multi-timeframe primary-range breakout is approximated by a prior 20-bar high break with an EMA(20) exit. Secondary-timeframe trailing distance, range multipliers, portfolio sizing, buffers, and pending-order state are not expressible in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Hybrid Scalper
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > bb_upper(close,20,2) and ema(close,10) > ema(close,30) and rsi(close,14) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: The source names RSI, dual EMA, and Bollinger inputs but gives no values; EMA(10/30), RSI(14), and Bollinger(20,2) are explicit fallbacks. The weekday and 1-minute filters, exact volatility limits, and order protections are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: ADX for BTC
strategy_roster.notes: The documented ADX entry 14 and exit 45 are retained; SMA(20) versus SMA(200) is an explicit fast/slow fallback because the source supplies only SmaLength. The optional 5-minute candle type is not part of this long-only daily DSL translation.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP is unavailable, so a 20-bar close average is used as the closest value-line proxy for the documented close-side breakout and reversal. The source gives no numeric stop or target value, and the 5-minute timeframe is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Virtual Profit/Loss Trail
strategy_roster.notes: The source never opens positions and only manages an existing position, so an impossible negative-price guard is used instead of fabricating an entry. Pip-based virtual stop, take-profit, and trailing levels are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: N7S AO 772012
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) and one-bar ROC provide a deterministic bullish momentum proxy for the Awesome Oscillator/perceptron decision tree. The multi-timeframe AO perceptrons, neural mode, price gate, and point-based protection are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Mission Impossible Power Two Open
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish completed candle is retained as the initial basket direction and the bearish candle is the opposite exit. Averaging grid, power sizing, shared pip targets, and maximum-trade controls require state and are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Dual Cloud
strategy_roster.notes: Fast RSI(7), slow RSI(21), and the 30/50 zone levels are explicit fallbacks because the source exposes names but no defaults. The configurable entrance/being/leaving/crossing toggles and reverse/long-only modes are represented by the long-zone interpretation.
